You gain X - you set the cost when you brought it into play.

> And
> what happens with kindred segregation?

It ignores it, since the 'pool cost' of a Reanimated Corpse is always
zero - RC has a blood cost, not a pool cost.

> If I kan move it from ash-heap
> into play. How many pathos counters does it gain?

Zero, and thus immediately burns - nothing about the cards that return
allies from the ash heap says 'and add pathos counters', only life.

cards.jyhad/msg/57031a1bf0d1c2c6)

> Ankara means you only pay half. However, the cost was still whatever it
> actually was.

That LSJ ruling never made sense to me. I get full-value for an ally
brought in via reduced cost (Charisma, Sunset Strip, etc.). It seems
that the Tower is evaluating the cost at the time of use and not
remembering incoming cost. So, why do we have to remember the
incoming cost for Corpses? Why not evaluate them when you use the
Towers?

Having to remember the cost also seems to run counter to not having to
remember multi-round effects, cf. LSJs discussion about why Dreams of
the Sphinx has counters.

LSJ, can you please verify what's going on here.

Karl
